parts.article_title: Five reviews of the Wellington Hotel

paragraphs.text: A

My husband and I first stayed at the Wellington a few years ago, and we've returned every year since then. When we arrive and check in, we're always treated like old friends by the staff, so we very much feel at home.Our one disappointment during our last visit was that our room overlooked the car park, but that didn't spoil our stay.
paragraphs.translation:
我和丈夫几年前第一次入住惠灵顿酒店，自那以后我们每年都回来。
当我们到达办理入住时，工作人员总是像对待老朋友一样招待我们，所以我们感到非常自在。
我们上次入住时唯一失望的是房间俯瞰停车场，但这并没有破坏我们的住宿体验。

paragraphs.text: B

The hotel hardly seems to have changed in the last hundred years,and we prefer that to many modern hotels, which tend to look the same as each other.The Wellington has character! Our room was very comfortable and quite spacious. We can strongly recommend the breakfast, though we had to wait for a table as the hotel was so full. That was a bit annoying, and there was also nowhere to sit in the lounge.
paragraphs.translation:
这家酒店在过去一百年里似乎几乎没有变化，而我们更喜欢这一点，而不是那些往往看起来千篇一律的现代酒店。
惠灵顿酒店独具特色！
我们的房间非常舒适，而且相当宽敞。
我们强烈推荐这里的早餐，尽管因为酒店住满了，我们不得不等位。
这有点烦人，而且休息室里也没有地方可坐。
这家酒店在过去的一百年里似乎几乎没有变化，而比起那些往往看起来千篇一律的现代酒店，我们更喜欢这一点。
我们强烈推荐这里的早餐，尽管因为酒店客满，我们不得不等位。
这有点令人烦恼，而且休息室里也没有地方可以坐。

paragraphs.text: C

We made our reservation by phone without problem, but when we arrived the receptionist couldn't see it on the computer system. Luckily there was a room available. It wasn't quite what we would have chosen, but it was a pleasure to sit in it with a cup of tea, and look out at the swimmers and surfers in the sea.
paragraphs.translation:
我们通过电话预订没有问题，但当到达时，前台接待员在电脑系统中找不到预订记录。
幸运的是，还有一个空房间。
虽然这间房间并不完全是我们原本会选择的那种，但坐在里面喝杯茶，眺望海中的游泳者和冲浪者，着实令人愉悦。
我们通过电话顺利完成了预订，但到达时接待员在电脑系统中找不到我们的预订信息。
这个房间并非我们原本会选择的那种，但坐在里面喝杯茶，眺望海中游泳和冲浪的人们，却是一种享受。

paragraphs.text: D

We'd be happy to stay at the Wellington again.Although there's nothing special about the rooms, the view from the lounge is lovely, and the restaurant staff were friendly and efficient. Breakfast was a highlight - there was so much on offer we could hardly decide what to eat. We'd stay another time just for that!
paragraphs.translation:
我们很乐意再次入住惠灵顿酒店。
虽然房间没什么特别之处，但休息室的景色很美，餐厅员工友好且高效。
早餐是一个亮点——提供的食物如此之多，我们几乎难以决定吃什么。
我们愿意为了早餐再去一次！
尽管房间没什么特别之处，但休息室的景色很迷人，餐厅员工也友好且高效。
早餐是一大亮点——供应的食物种类繁多，我们几乎难以决定该吃什么。
仅为了这顿早餐，我们也愿意再次入住！

paragraphs.text: E

The staff all did their jobs efficiently, and were very helpful when we asked for information about the area. The only difficulty we had was making our reservation online - it wasn't clear whether payment for our deposit went through or not, and I had to call the hotel to find out. Still, once we'd arrived, everything went very smoothly, and we had a delicious dinner in the restaurant.
paragraphs.translation:
所有员工都高效地完成了自己的工作，当我们询问关于该地区的信息时，他们也十分乐于助人。
我们遇到的唯一困难是在线预订——不清楚我们的定金是否支付成功，我不得不打电话给酒店来确认。
不过，一旦我们到达后，一切都很顺利，我们还在餐厅享用了美味的晚餐。
所有员工都高效地完成了自己的工作，并且在我们询问该地区的信息时给予了极大的帮助。

不过，一旦我们到达，一切进行得非常顺利，我们在餐厅享用了美味的晚餐。

paragraphs.text: Come and play walking football or walking netball
paragraphs.translation: 快来参加健步足球或健步篮网球吧。

paragraphs.text: Walking football and netball have become increasingly popular in recent years, but do you know you can take part in this area? The names make it clear what they are - two of the country's favourite sports where, instead of running, the players walk. It's as simple as that.
paragraphs.translation:
近年来，步行足球和步行篮网球越来越受欢迎，但你知道你可以在这个地区参与其中吗？
这些名称清楚地说明了它们是什么——两项该国最受欢迎的运动，其中参与者走路而非跑步。
就是这么简单。

paragraphs.text: Walking football was invented in the UK in 2011, but it was a 2014 TV commercial for a bank, showing it providing financial support to someone who wanted to set up a website for the game, that brought it to people's attention. Since then, tens of thousands of people -mostly, though not only, over the age of 50 - have started playing, and there are more than 800 walking football clubs.Both men and women play walking football, but at the moment the netball teams consist only of women.However, men are beginning to show an interest in playing.
paragraphs.translation:
步行足球于2011年在英国发明，但直到2014年一家银行的电视广告——该广告展示了银行为一位想要为这项运动建立网站的人提供资金支持——才使人们注意到它。
自那时起，数万人——尽管并非全部，但主要是50岁以上的人——开始参与这项运动，并且已有超过800个步行足球俱乐部。
男性和女性都可以玩步行足球，但目前无挡板篮球队只由女性组成。
然而，男性开始对参与这项运动表现出兴趣。

paragraphs.text: The two games are designed to help people to be active or get fit, whatever their age and level of fitness. In particular, they were invented to encourage older men and women to get more exercise, and to give them a chance to meet other people. Regular physical activity helps to maintain energy, strength and flexibility. You can start gently and do a little more each session.The benefits include lower heart rate and blood pressure, greater mobility, less fat and more muscle.
paragraphs.translation:
这两种运动旨在帮助人们保持活跃或增强体质，无论其年龄和健康水平如何。
特别是，它们的发明是为了鼓励老年男性和女性多进行锻炼，并为他们提供结识他人的机会。
定期的身体活动有助于维持精力、力量和柔韧性。
你可以从轻松的开始做起，每次训练逐渐增加一点运动量。
这些益处包括降低心率和血压、提高身体灵活性、减少脂肪以及增加肌肉。

paragraphs.text: Many players have given up a sport - either through age or injury - and can now take it up again. They're great ways for people to enjoy a sport they used to play and love, and keep active at the same time, though people who have never played the standard game before are also very welcome.
paragraphs.translation:
许多球员因为年龄或伤病而放弃了一项运动，而现在他们可以重新拾起这项运动。
这些运动是让人们享受他们曾经参与并热爱的运动、同时保持活力的绝佳方式，尽管之前从未玩过标准比赛的人也非常受欢迎。

paragraphs.text: The local council's Active Lifestyles Team runs sessions at all the council's leisure centres. Come alone or with a friend, and enjoy a friendly game on Monday or Saturday afternoons,or Tuesday or Thursday evenings. Each session costs £3 per person, and you don’t have to come regularly or at the same time each week. Our aim is to set up netball and football clubs as soon as there are enough regular players.
paragraphs.translation:
当地议会的活跃生活方式团队在所有议会的休闲中心举办活动。
你可以独自前来或与朋友一起，在周一或周六下午、周二或周四晚上享受一场友好的比赛。
每次活动每人收费3英镑，你不需要定期参加，也不必每周在同一时间前来。
我们的目标是，一旦有足够的常客，就尽快组建篮网球和足球俱乐部。

sentence_translations.sentence: Although there's nothing special about the rooms, the view from the lounge is lovely, and the restaurant staff were friendly and efficient.

sentence_translations.sentence: The staff all did their jobs efficiently, and were very helpful when we asked for information about the area.

sentence_translations.sentence: The only difficulty we had was making our reservation online - it wasn't clear whether payment for our deposit went through or not, and I had to call the hotel to find out.

sentence_translations.sentence: Come and play walking football or walking netball
sentence_translations.translation: 快来参加健步足球或健步篮网球吧。

sentence_translations.sentence: Walking football and netball have become increasingly popular in recent years, but do you know you can take part in this area?
sentence_translations.translation: 近年来，步行足球和步行篮网球越来越受欢迎，但你知道你可以在这个地区参与其中吗？

sentence_translations.sentence: The names make it clear what they are - two of the country's favourite sports where, instead of running, the players walk.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些名称清楚地说明了它们是什么——两项该国最受欢迎的运动，其中参与者走路而非跑步。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's as simple as that.
sentence_translations.translation: 就是这么简单。

sentence_translations.sentence: Walking football was invented in the UK in 2011, but it was a 2014 TV commercial for a bank, showing it providing financial support to someone who wanted to set up a website for the game, that brought it to people's attention.
sentence_translations.translation: 步行足球于2011年在英国发明，但直到2014年一家银行的电视广告——该广告展示了银行为一位想要为这项运动建立网站的人提供资金支持——才使人们注意到它。

sentence_translations.sentence: Since then, tens of thousands of people -mostly, though not only, over the age of 50 - have started playing, and there are more than 800 walking football clubs.
sentence_translations.translation: 自那时起，数万人——尽管并非全部，但主要是50岁以上的人——开始参与这项运动，并且已有超过800个步行足球俱乐部。

sentence_translations.sentence: Both men and women play walking football, but at the moment the netball teams consist only of women.
sentence_translations.translation: 男性和女性都可以玩步行足球，但目前无挡板篮球队只由女性组成。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, men are beginning to show an interest in playing.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，男性开始对参与这项运动表现出兴趣。

sentence_translations.sentence: The two games are designed to help people to be active or get fit, whatever their age and level of fitness.
sentence_translations.translation: 这两种运动旨在帮助人们保持活跃或增强体质，无论其年龄和健康水平如何。

sentence_translations.sentence: In particular, they were invented to encourage older men and women to get more exercise, and to give them a chance to meet other people.
sentence_translations.translation: 特别是，它们的发明是为了鼓励老年男性和女性多进行锻炼，并为他们提供结识他人的机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: Regular physical activity helps to maintain energy, strength and flexibility.
sentence_translations.translation: 定期的身体活动有助于维持精力、力量和柔韧性。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can start gently and do a little more each session.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以从轻松的开始做起，每次训练逐渐增加一点运动量。

sentence_translations.sentence: The benefits include lower heart rate and blood pressure, greater mobility, less fat and more muscle.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些益处包括降低心率和血压、提高身体灵活性、减少脂肪以及增加肌肉。

sentence_translations.sentence: Many players have given up a sport - either through age or injury - and can now take it up again.
sentence_translations.translation: 许多球员因为年龄或伤病而放弃了一项运动，而现在他们可以重新拾起这项运动。

sentence_translations.sentence: They're great ways for people to enjoy a sport they used to play and love, and keep active at the same time, though people who have never played the standard game before are also very welcome.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些运动是让人们享受他们曾经参与并热爱的运动、同时保持活力的绝佳方式，尽管之前从未玩过标准比赛的人也非常受欢迎。

sentence_translations.sentence: The local council's Active Lifestyles Team runs sessions at all the council's leisure centres.
sentence_translations.translation: 当地议会的活跃生活方式团队在所有议会的休闲中心举办活动。

sentence_translations.sentence: Come alone or with a friend, and enjoy a friendly game on Monday or Saturday afternoons, or Tuesday or Thursday evenings.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以独自前来或与朋友一起，在周一或周六下午、周二或周四晚上享受一场友好的比赛。

sentence_translations.sentence: Each session costs £3 per person, and you don’t have to come regularly or at the same time each week.
sentence_translations.translation: 每次活动每人收费3英镑，你不需要定期参加，也不必每周在同一时间前来。

sentence_translations.sentence: Our aim is to set up netball and football clubs as soon as there are enough regular players.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们的目标是，一旦有足够的常客，就尽快组建篮网球和足球俱乐部。

paragraphs.text: Your contract may state that you need to dress in a certain manner or wear a uniform.Your contract might also state that you need to dress 'smartly, rather than specifying any particular garments. As you might well have conflicting ideas of what counts as 'smart',you should ask your employer for clarification. Many employers that have a strict dress code choose to provide clothing or a discount on clothing.However, this is not necessarily compulsory for the employer and is a factor you need to consider when taking a job.
paragraphs.translation:
你的合同可能会规定你需要以某种方式着装或穿制服。
你的合同也可能规定你需要穿得‘得体’，而不是指定任何特定的服装。
由于你对什么算‘得体’很可能有相互矛盾的想法，你应该向雇主询问清楚。
许多有严格着装规定的雇主选择提供服装或服装折扣。
然而，这对雇主来说不一定是强制性的，而是你在接受工作时需要考虑的一个因素。

paragraphs.text: Protective clothing and equipment
paragraphs.translation: 防护服与防护装备

paragraphs.text: Your employer can tell you to put on protective clothing and equipment (such as gloves, a visor, boots, etc.). If you don't, your employer is entitled to take disciplinary action, which can include excluding you from the workplace.
paragraphs.translation:
防护服与防护装备
您的雇主可以要求您穿戴防护服装和设备（例如手套、面罩、靴子等）。
如果您不这样做，雇主有权采取纪律处分，其中可能包括将您排除在工作场所之外。

paragraphs.text: You are required to:
paragraphs.translation: 你必须做到：

paragraphs.text: • co-operate with your employer on health and safety
paragraphs.translation: • 在健康与安全方面与雇主合作

paragraphs.text: • correctly use work items provided by your employer, including protective equipment, in accordance with instructions
paragraphs.translation: • 根据指示正确使用雇主提供的工作物品，包括防护设备。

paragraphs.text: • not interfere with or misuse anything provided for your health and safety or welfare.
paragraphs.translation: • 不得干扰或滥用任何为您的健康、安全或福祉提供的物品。

paragraphs.text: Of course, any protective gear has to fit and be appropriate for the situation. It shouldn’t cause you pain. If it does, you should negotiate alternative equipment or arrangements.Don't be put off. Sometimes employers can, out of caution, interpret health and safety rules unnecessarily rigidly. And of course you shouldn’t be required to pay for any protective equipment or clothing that you need. However, if your employer buys the gear, they are entitled to keep it when you leave.
paragraphs.translation:
当然，任何防护装备都必须合身且适合具体情况。
它不应该让你感到疼痛。
如果确实如此，你应该协商替代的装备或安排。
不要因此退缩。
有时，雇主出于谨慎，可能会过度刻板地解释健康与安全规定。
当然，你不应该被要求为你所需的任何防护装备或服装付费。
然而，如果雇主购买了这些装备，他们有权在你离职时将其保留。

paragraphs.text: The obligation to maintain protective clothing lies with the employer. The employer is also required to provide an appropriate storage space to keep the protective equipment in when it is not being used.And finally, the employer must provide the equipment and service free of charge to the employee.
paragraphs.translation:
维护防护服的责任在于雇主。
雇主还需要提供合适的储存空间，以便在防护设备不使用时存放。
最后，雇主必须免费向员工提供设备和服务。

paragraphs.text: Jewellery
paragraphs.translation: 珠宝首饰

paragraphs.text: Banning employees from wearing jewellery and loose clothing may be justified to prevent a potential hygiene hazard if you work in areas of food production or areas which need to be kept sterile.
paragraphs.translation:
珠宝首饰
如果你在食品生产区域或需要保持无菌环境的区域工作，禁止员工佩戴首饰和穿着宽松服装可能是合理的，以防止潜在的卫生风险。

paragraphs.text: Likewise, your employer can judge that loose jewellery may constitute a snagging hazard if you operate machinery. If you think restrictions are not justified by health and safety concerns, talk to your workplace union rep if you have one, as they may know of solutions to the problem which other employees have used before.
paragraphs.translation:
珠宝首饰
同样地，如果你操作机器，雇主可以判定宽松的珠宝可能构成缠绕危险。
如果你认为这些限制并非出于健康与安全考虑，可以向你的工作场所工会代表（如果有的话）反映，因为他们可能了解其他员工曾经用过的解决方案。

paragraphs.text: How to achieve a better work-life balance
paragraphs.translation: 如何实现更好的工作与生活平衡

paragraphs.text: As more and more employees work from home full time and everyone has 24/7 access to email, balancing work and family may not seem like an easily attainable goal. So how can you juggle the demands of both worlds? Below are some tips to help you get started.
paragraphs.translation:
随着越来越多的员工全职在家办公，且所有人每周7天、每天24小时都能访问电子邮件，平衡工作与家庭似乎并非易事。
那么，你该如何兼顾这两个领域的需求呢？
以下是一些建议，可帮助你开始行动。

paragraphs.text: It's easy to get sucked into habits that make us less efficient without realizing it - like keeping your social media page open at work so you don't miss something 'important'. Draw up a list with all the activities that don't enhance your life or career.Then minimize the time you spend on them.
paragraphs.translation:
我们很容易在不自知的情况下陷入那些降低效率的习惯中——比如工作时开着社交媒体页面，以免错过某些“重要”信息。
列出一份清单，包含所有无益于你生活或职业的活动。
然后尽量减少花在这些活动上的时间。

paragraphs.text: It's hard to say 'no' , especially to a supervisor or loved one, but sometimes that powerful little word is essential. Learn to use 'no' judiciously and it will become a powerful tool in balancing work and family.
paragraphs.translation:
说‘不’很难，尤其是对上司或爱人，但有时这个简短有力的词至关重要。
学会明智地使用‘不’，它将成为一个平衡工作与家庭的强大工具。

paragraphs.text: Research shows that exercise helps you remain alert. Finding time to hit the gym may be hard, but it will ultimately help you get more things done because exercise really boosts energy and improves your ability to concentrate.
paragraphs.translation:
研究表明，锻炼有助于你保持警觉。
抽时间去健身房可能很困难，但最终它会帮你完成更多事情，因为锻炼确实能提升精力并改善你的专注力。

paragraphs.text: Study after study shows that significant sleep deprivation affects your health and well-being.Exposure to electronics can significantly negatively impact your sleep, so try to unplug an hour before you go to sleep.
paragraphs.translation:
一项又一项研究表明，严重的睡眠不足会影响你的健康和幸福感。
接触电子设备会对你的睡眠产生显著的负面影响，因此请在入睡前一小时尽量断开电子设备。

paragraphs.text: What would you do if you had a whole day to yourself with no demands on your time? While most people don’t have the luxury of a whole day dedicated to relaxation, constantly putting off that downtime and putting everyone's needs before yours will wear you down.Pick a time to do something just for you. Even just a few minutes of 'me time' a day will help to recharge your batteries.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你有一整天完全属于自己的时间，没有任何时间上的要求，你会做什么？
虽然大多数人没有奢侈到能拥有一整天来放松，但不断推迟休息时间、把他人的需求置于自己之前，会让你筋疲力尽。
选择一个时间，为自己做点事情。
即使每天只有几分钟的“自我时间”，也能帮助你重新充电。

paragraphs.text: Don’t assume your family and manager are aware of your concerns. If you feel you have to adjust your schedule to discover a better work-life balance, then voice that requirement. If that means asking your boss for permission to leave a few minutes early once a week so you can hit that yoga class on the way home, do it.
paragraphs.translation:
不要假设你的家人和经理了解你的担忧。
如果你觉得必须调整日程以找到更好的工作与生活平衡，那就提出这一要求。
如果这意味着每周一次请求老板允许你提前几分钟下班，以便在回家途中赶上瑜伽课，那就去做。

paragraphs.text: All new habits require time to build, so if you find yourself sneaking your smartphone to bed, that's okay. Leave your phone downstairs tomorrow night. Tiny steps are the key to finding that balance, so start small, and go from there. Most of all, know your limitations and what works best for you; then decide what really matters, what advice you want to follow, and prioritize.
paragraphs.translation:
所有新习惯都需要时间来养成，因此，如果你发现自己忍不住把智能手机带到床上，这也没关系。
明晚把手机留在楼下。
微小的步骤是找到平衡的关键，所以从小处着手，然后逐步推进。
最重要的是，了解自己的局限以及最适合自己的方法；然后决定什么真正重要、你想遵循哪些建议，并设定优先顺序。

questions.prompt: If employees are unsure what their company wishes them to wear for work, they should request _____.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“request”对应原文中的“ask for”，而“unsure what their company wishes them to wear”对应原文中提到的“conflicting ideas of what counts as 'smart'”。因此，员工应向雇主请求 clarification（澄清），这是原文明确建议的做法。
questions.reason: 原文明确建议 ask for clarification

questions.paraphrasing: unsure -> conflicting ideas; request -> ask for
evidence: As you might well have conflicting ideas of what counts as 'smart',you should ask your employer for clarification.

questions.prompt: Some companies offer their employees a _____ when they buy items to wear for work.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“offer...a discount when they buy items to wear”与原文“provide clothing or a discount on clothing”形成同义替换。其中“discount”直接出现在原文中，且语境完全匹配公司为员工购衣提供折扣的情形，因此答案为 discount。
questions.reason: 题干a discount对应原文discount on clothing。
questions.location_analysis: 原文：provide ... discount on clothing. 对应discount。
questions.paraphrasing: offer -> provide; buy items -> purchase clothing
evidence: Many employers that have a strict dress code choose to provide clothing or a discount on clothing.

questions.prompt: Employees who fail to wear protective clothing when required could be subject to _____ procedures.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“subject to...procedures”对应原文中的“take disciplinary action”，即员工若未按规定穿戴防护装备，雇主有权采取纪律处分措施。“disciplinary”是原文中“disciplinary action”的核心词，符合题目要求填写一个单词的限制。
questions.reason: 题干subject to...procedures对应原文disciplinary action。
questions.location_analysis: 原文：entitled to take disciplinary action. 对应disc...
questions.paraphrasing: fail to wear -> don't put on; disciplinary procedures -> disciplinary action
questions.keywords: fail to wear protective clothing, disciplinary
evidence: If you don't, your employer is entitled to take disciplinary action, which can include excluding you from the workplace.

questions.prompt: Employees ought not to be in _____ because of protective clothing or equipment.
questions.analysis: 题干要求填写因防护装备而不应处于的状态，原文明确指出“It shouldn’t cause you pain”，即防护装备不应导致疼痛。因此，“pain”是直接从原文提取的准确答案，符合“ONE WORD ONLY”的要求。
questions.reason: 答案句直接包含'pain'。
questions.location_analysis: 第六段强调防护装备不应使员工感到疼痛。
questions.paraphrasing: in pain -> cause you pain
evidence: It shouldn’t cause you pain.

questions.prompt: It is the company’s responsibility to ensure that there is a suitable place for the _____ of protective equipment.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“suitable place for the...of protective equipment”对应原文中的“provide an appropriate storage space to keep the protective equipment”。其中“storage”是“storage space”的核心名词，准确表达了存放防护设备的含义，因此答案为 storage。
questions.reason: 题干place for storage对应原文storage space。
questions.location_analysis: 原文：provide storage space. 对应storage。
questions.paraphrasing: suitable place for -> appropriate storage space
evidence: The employer is also required to provide an appropriate storage space to keep the protective equipment in when it is not being used.

questions.prompt: Employees who work with certain types of _____ may have to remove jewellery to avoid potential injuries.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“work with certain types of...”对应原文中的“if you operate machinery”，而“remove jewellery to avoid potential injuries”对应“loose jewellery may constitute a snagging hazard”。因此，此处应填 machinery，指操作机械时需摘除首饰以防危险。
questions.reason: 题干work with...machinery对应operate machinery。
questions.location_analysis: 原文：operate machinery...snagging hazard. 对应machi...
questions.paraphrasing: certain types of -> operate; remove jewellery -> restrictions; injuries -> snagging hazard
evidence: Likewise, your employer can judge that loose jewellery may constitute a snagging hazard if you operate machinery.

sentence_translations.sentence: Your contract may state that you need to dress in a certain manner or wear a uniform.
sentence_translations.translation: 你的合同可能会规定你需要以某种方式着装或穿制服。

sentence_translations.sentence: Your contract might also state that you need to dress 'smartly', rather than specifying any particular garments.
sentence_translations.translation: 你的合同也可能规定你需要穿得‘得体’，而不是指定任何特定的服装。

sentence_translations.sentence: As you might well have conflicting ideas of what counts as 'smart', you should ask your employer for clarification.
sentence_translations.translation: 由于你对什么算‘得体’很可能有相互矛盾的想法，你应该向雇主询问清楚。

sentence_translations.sentence: Many employers that have a strict dress code choose to provide clothing or a discount on clothing.
sentence_translations.translation: 许多有严格着装规定的雇主选择提供服装或服装折扣。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, this is not necessarily compulsory for the employer and is a factor you need to consider when taking a job.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，这对雇主来说不一定是强制性的，而是你在接受工作时需要考虑的一个因素。

sentence_translations.sentence: Protective clothing and equipment
sentence_translations.translation: 防护服与防护装备

sentence_translations.sentence: Your employer can tell you to put on protective clothing and equipment (such as gloves, a visor, boots, etc.).
sentence_translations.translation: 您的雇主可以要求您穿戴防护服装和设备（例如手套、面罩、靴子等）。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you don't, your employer is entitled to take disciplinary action, which can include excluding you from the workplace.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果您不这样做，雇主有权采取纪律处分，其中可能包括将您排除在工作场所之外。

sentence_translations.sentence: You are required to:
sentence_translations.translation: 你必须做到：

sentence_translations.sentence: • co-operate with your employer on health and safety
sentence_translations.translation: • 在健康与安全方面与雇主合作

sentence_translations.sentence: • correctly use work items provided by your employer, including protective equipment, in accordance with instructions
sentence_translations.translation: • 根据指示正确使用雇主提供的工作物品，包括防护设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: • not interfere with or misuse anything provided for your health and safety or welfare.
sentence_translations.translation: • 不得干扰或滥用任何为您的健康、安全或福祉提供的物品。

sentence_translations.sentence: Of course, any protective gear has to fit and be appropriate for the situation.
sentence_translations.translation: 当然，任何防护装备都必须合身且适合具体情况。

sentence_translations.sentence: It shouldn’t cause you pain.
sentence_translations.translation: 它不应该让你感到疼痛。

sentence_translations.sentence: If it does, you should negotiate alternative equipment or arrangements.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果确实如此，你应该协商替代的装备或安排。

sentence_translations.sentence: Don't be put off.
sentence_translations.translation: 不要因此退缩。

sentence_translations.sentence: Sometimes employers can, out of caution, interpret health and safety rules unnecessarily rigidly.
sentence_translations.translation: 有时，雇主出于谨慎，可能会过度刻板地解释健康与安全规定。

sentence_translations.sentence: And of course you shouldn’t be required to pay for any protective equipment or clothing that you need.
sentence_translations.translation: 当然，你不应该被要求为你所需的任何防护装备或服装付费。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, if your employer buys the gear, they are entitled to keep it when you leave.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，如果雇主购买了这些装备，他们有权在你离职时将其保留。

sentence_translations.sentence: The obligation to maintain protective clothing lies with the employer.
sentence_translations.translation: 维护防护服的责任在于雇主。

sentence_translations.sentence: The employer is also required to provide an appropriate storage space to keep the protective equipment in when it is not being used.
sentence_translations.translation: 雇主还需要提供合适的储存空间，以便在防护设备不使用时存放。

sentence_translations.sentence: And finally, the employer must provide the equipment and service free of charge to the employee.
sentence_translations.translation: 最后，雇主必须免费向员工提供设备和服务。

sentence_translations.sentence: Jewellery
sentence_translations.translation: 珠宝首饰

sentence_translations.sentence: Banning employees from wearing jewellery and loose clothing may be justified to prevent a potential hygiene hazard if you work in areas of food production or areas which need to be kept sterile.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你在食品生产区域或需要保持无菌环境的区域工作，禁止员工佩戴首饰和穿着宽松服装可能是合理的，以防止潜在的卫生风险。

sentence_translations.sentence: Likewise, your employer can judge that loose jewellery may constitute a snagging hazard if you operate machinery.
sentence_translations.translation: 同样地，如果你操作机器，雇主可以判定宽松的珠宝可能构成缠绕危险。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you think restrictions are not justified by health and safety concerns, talk to your workplace union rep if you have one, as they may know of solutions to the problem which other employees have used before.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你认为这些限制并非出于健康与安全考虑，可以向你的工作场所工会代表（如果有的话）反映，因为他们可能了解其他员工曾经用过的解决方案。

sentence_translations.sentence: How to achieve a better work-life balance
sentence_translations.translation: 如何实现更好的工作与生活平衡

sentence_translations.sentence: As more and more employees work from home full time and everyone has 24/7 access to email, balancing work and family may not seem like an easily attainable goal.
sentence_translations.translation: 随着越来越多的员工全职在家办公，且所有人每周7天、每天24小时都能访问电子邮件，平衡工作与家庭似乎并非易事。

sentence_translations.sentence: So how can you juggle the demands of both worlds?
sentence_translations.translation: 那么，你该如何兼顾这两个领域的需求呢？

sentence_translations.sentence: Below are some tips to help you get started.
sentence_translations.translation: 以下是一些建议，可帮助你开始行动。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's easy to get sucked into habits that make us less efficient without realizing it - like keeping your social media page open at work so you don't miss something 'important'.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们很容易在不自知的情况下陷入那些降低效率的习惯中——比如工作时开着社交媒体页面，以免错过某些“重要”信息。

sentence_translations.sentence: Draw up a list with all the activities that don't enhance your life or career.
sentence_translations.translation: 列出一份清单，包含所有无益于你生活或职业的活动。

sentence_translations.sentence: Then minimize the time you spend on them.
sentence_translations.translation: 然后尽量减少花在这些活动上的时间。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's hard to say 'no', especially to a supervisor or loved one, but sometimes that powerful little word is essential.
sentence_translations.translation: 说‘不’很难，尤其是对上司或爱人，但有时这个简短有力的词至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: Learn to use 'no' judiciously and it will become a powerful tool in balancing work and family.
sentence_translations.translation: 学会明智地使用‘不’，它将成为一个平衡工作与家庭的强大工具。

sentence_translations.sentence: Research shows that exercise helps you remain alert.
sentence_translations.translation: 研究表明，锻炼有助于你保持警觉。

sentence_translations.sentence: Finding time to hit the gym may be hard, but it will ultimately help you get more things done because exercise really boosts energy and improves your ability to concentrate.
sentence_translations.translation: 抽时间去健身房可能很困难，但最终它会帮你完成更多事情，因为锻炼确实能提升精力并改善你的专注力。

sentence_translations.sentence: Study after study shows that significant sleep deprivation affects your health and well-being.
sentence_translations.translation: 一项又一项研究表明，严重的睡眠不足会影响你的健康和幸福感。

sentence_translations.sentence: Exposure to electronics can significantly negatively impact your sleep, so try to unplug an hour before you go to sleep.
sentence_translations.translation: 接触电子设备会对你的睡眠产生显著的负面影响，因此请在入睡前一小时尽量断开电子设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: What would you do if you had a whole day to yourself with no demands on your time?
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你有一整天完全属于自己的时间，没有任何时间上的要求，你会做什么？

sentence_translations.sentence: While most people don’t have the luxury of a whole day dedicated to relaxation, constantly putting off that downtime and putting everyone's needs before yours will wear you down.
sentence_translations.translation: 虽然大多数人没有奢侈到能拥有一整天来放松，但不断推迟休息时间、把他人的需求置于自己之前，会让你筋疲力尽。

sentence_translations.sentence: Pick a time to do something just for you.
sentence_translations.translation: 选择一个时间，为自己做点事情。

sentence_translations.sentence: Even just a few minutes of 'me time' a day will help to recharge your batteries.
sentence_translations.translation: 即使每天只有几分钟的“自我时间”，也能帮助你重新充电。

sentence_translations.sentence: Don’t assume your family and manager are aware of your concerns.
sentence_translations.translation: 不要假设你的家人和经理了解你的担忧。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you feel you have to adjust your schedule to discover a better work-life balance, then voice that requirement.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你觉得必须调整日程以找到更好的工作与生活平衡，那就提出这一要求。

sentence_translations.sentence: If that means asking your boss for permission to leave a few minutes early once a week so you can hit that yoga class on the way home, do it.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果这意味着每周一次请求老板允许你提前几分钟下班，以便在回家途中赶上瑜伽课，那就去做。

sentence_translations.sentence: All new habits require time to build, so if you find yourself sneaking your smartphone to bed, that's okay.
sentence_translations.translation: 所有新习惯都需要时间来养成，因此，如果你发现自己忍不住把智能手机带到床上，这也没关系。

sentence_translations.sentence: Leave your phone downstairs tomorrow night.
sentence_translations.translation: 明晚把手机留在楼下。

sentence_translations.sentence: Tiny steps are the key to finding that balance, so start small, and go from there.
sentence_translations.translation: 微小的步骤是找到平衡的关键，所以从小处着手，然后逐步推进。

sentence_translations.sentence: Most of all, know your limitations and what works best for you; then decide what really matters, what advice you want to follow, and prioritize.
sentence_translations.translation: 最重要的是，了解自己的局限以及最适合自己的方法；然后决定什么真正重要、你想遵循哪些建议，并设定优先顺序。

paragraphs.text: A

For several decades in the nineteenth century, there were calls to connect the rapidly growing metropolis of San Francisco to its neighbours across the mile-wide Golden Gate Strait, where San Francisco Bay opens onto the Pacific Ocean.Eventually, in 1919, officials asked the city engineer,Michael O'Shaughnessy, to explore the possibility of building a bridge. He began to consult engineers across the USA about the feasibility of doing so, and the cost. Most doubted whether a bridge could be built at all, or estimated that it would cost $100 million. However,a Chicago-based engineer named Joseph Strauss believed he could complete the project for a modest $25 to $30 million.After his proposal was accepted,Strauss set about convincing the communities on the northern end of the strait that the bridge would be to their benefit, as well as to that of San Francisco. With population centres growing fast, there was severe traffic congestion at the ferry docks, and motor vehicle travel by ferry was fast exceeding capacity.
paragraphs.translation:
在19世纪的几十年里，一直有人呼吁将快速发展的旧金山大都市与其跨越一英里宽的金门海峡的邻居连接起来，旧金山湾在此处汇入太平洋。
最终，在1919年，官员们要求城市工程师迈克尔·奥肖内西探索建造一座桥梁的可能性。
他开始咨询美国各地的工程师，讨论这样做的可行性以及成本。
大多数人怀疑是否真的能建造一座桥梁，或者估计它将耗资1亿美元。
然而，一位名叫约瑟夫·斯特劳斯的芝加哥工程师认为，他可以用适中的2500万到3000万美元完成该项目。
在他的提议被接受后，斯特劳斯开始说服海峡北端的社区，这座桥梁将对他们以及旧金山都有利。
随着人口中心的快速增长，渡轮码头出现了严重的交通拥堵，而通过渡轮进行的机动车出行很快超过了运力。

paragraphs.text: B

The bridge could not be constructed without the agreement of the U.S. War Department, which owned the land on each side of the Strait and had the power to prevent any harbour construction that might affect shipping traffic. In 1924,San Francisco and Marin counties applied for a permit to build a bridge, and after hearing overwhelming arguments in favour of the project, the Secretary of War agreed.
paragraphs.translation:
这座桥的建造必须获得美国战争部的同意，该部门拥有海峡两岸的土地，并有权阻止任何可能影响航运的港口建设。
1924年，旧金山和马林县申请建造桥梁的许可证，在听取了大量支持该项目的论据后，战争部长同意了。
如果没有美国战争部的同意，这座桥是无法建造的，因为该部门拥有海峡两岸的土地，并且有权阻止任何可能影响航运的港口建设。
1924年，旧金山和马林县申请了建桥许可，在听取了大量支持该项目的论点后，战争部长同意了。

paragraphs.text: Despite the economic benefits promised by its supporters, the project met fierce resistance from a number of businesses - particularly ferry companies - and civic leaders. Not only would the bridge be an obstacle to shipping and spoil the bay's natural beauty, they argued, it wouldn't survive the sort of earthquake that had devastated the city in 1906. Eight years of legal actions followed as opponents tried to prevent it from being built.
paragraphs.translation:
尽管支持者承诺了经济效益，该项目仍遭到许多企业——尤其是渡轮公司——和市政领导人的强烈反对。
他们争辩说，这座桥不仅会成为航运的障碍并破坏海湾的自然美景，而且无法承受曾在1906年摧毁该市的那种地震。
随后，反对者试图阻止桥梁建设，引发了长达八年的法律诉讼。

桥跨能够向每侧移动超过两英尺：这比刚性结构能更好地抵御强风。

paragraphs.text: D

O'Shaughnessy, Strauss and the Secretary to the Mayor of San Francisco believed a special district needed to be created, with responsibility for planning,designing and financing construction.The formation of this district would enable all the counties affected by the bridge to have a say in the proceedings. This happened in 1928, when the California legislature passed an act to establish the Golden Gate Bridge and Highway District, consisting of six counties. In 1930, residents voted on the question of whether to put up their homes, their farms and their business properties as security for a $35 million bond issue to finance construction.The outcome was a large majority in favour.

奥肖内西、施特劳斯和旧金山市长的秘书认为需要成立一个特别区，负责规划、设计和资助建设。
该区的成立将使所有受大桥影响的县在相关事务中拥有发言权。

结果是绝大多数人表示赞成。

paragraphs.text: However, the District struggled to find a financial backer amid the difficulties of the Great Depression, a problem made worse by years of expensive legal proceedings. Now desperate, Strauss personally sought help from the President of Bank of America, who provided a crucial boost by agreeing to buy $6 million in bonds in 1932.

然而，在大萧条的困境中，该区难以找到财务支持者，而多年的昂贵法律诉讼使这一问题雪上加霜。
如今陷入绝望的斯特劳斯亲自向美国银行行长寻求帮助，后者同意在1932年购买600万美元的债券，从而提供了关键的推动。

paragraphs.text: E

Construction began in January 1933, with the excavation of a vast amount of rock to establish the bridge's two anchorages - the structures in the ground that would take the tension from the suspension cables.The crew consisted of virtually anyone capable of withstanding the physical rigours of the job, as out-of-work cab drivers, farmers and clerks lined up for the chance to earn steady wages as ironworkers and cement mixers.
paragraphs.translation:
工程于1933年1月开始，首先挖掘大量岩石以建立桥梁的两个锚碇——这些地面结构将承受来自悬索的拉力。
施工队伍几乎由任何能够承受工作体力强度的人组成，失业的出租车司机、农民和职员排队等待机会，成为铁匠和水泥搅拌工以赚取稳定的工资。

paragraphs.text: The attempt to build what would be the first bridge support in the open ocean proved an immense challenge. Working from a long framework built out from the San Francisco side, divers plunged to depths of 90 feet through strong currents to blast away rock and remove the debris.The framework was damaged when it was struck by a ship in August 1933 and again during a powerful storm later in the year, setting construction back five months.
paragraphs.translation:
建造第一个位于开阔海洋中的桥梁支撑结构的尝试被证明是一个巨大的挑战。
潜水员们从旧金山一侧延伸出的长框架出发，在强流中潜入90英尺深的水下，炸开岩石并清除碎屑。
该框架在1933年8月被一艘船撞损，同年晚些时候又在一场猛烈风暴中受损，导致施工推迟了五个月。

paragraphs.text: F

The two towers were completed in June 1935, and a New Jersey-based company was appointed to handle the on-site construction of the suspension cables. Its engineers had mastered a technique in which individual steel wires were banded together in spools and carried across the length of the bridge on spinning wheels.Given a year to complete the task, they instead finished in just over six months, having spun more than 25,000 individual wires into each massive cable.
paragraphs.translation:
这两座塔楼于1935年6月完工，一家位于新泽西的公司被指定负责悬索的现场施工。
其工程师掌握了一种技术，将单根钢丝捆扎成线轴，并通过旋转轮将其运送到整个桥面上。
尽管任务被给予一年时间完成，但他们仅用六个多月就完工了，将超过25,000根单根钢丝编织成每根巨大的缆索。

paragraphs.text: The roadway was completed in April 1937, and the bridge officially opened to pedestrians the following month.The next day, President Roosevelt announced its opening via White House telegraph.
paragraphs.translation:
桥面于1937年4月完工，桥于次月正式向行人开放。
次日，罗斯福总统通过白宫电报宣布大桥开通。

paragraphs.text: G

The Golden Gate has endured as a marvel of modern engineering; its main span was the longest in the world for a suspension bridge until 1981, while its towers made it the tallest bridge of any type until 1993. It withstood a destructive earthquake in 1989 and was closed to traffic only three times in its first 75 years due to weather conditions.Believed to be the most photographed bridge in the world, this landmark was named one of the seven civil engineering wonders of the United States by the American Society of Civil Engineers in 1994.
paragraphs.translation:
金门大桥作为现代工程的奇迹经久不衰；其主跨距在1981年之前一直是世界上悬索桥中最长的，而其桥塔则使其成为1993年之前所有类型桥梁中最高的一座。
它经受住了1989年破坏性地震的考验，并在其最初75年间因天气原因仅对交通关闭了三次。
这座被认为是世界上被拍摄次数最多的桥梁的地标性建筑，于1994年被美国土木工程师协会命名为美国七大土木工程奇观之一。
金门大桥作为现代工程的奇迹屹立至今；
其主跨距在1981年之前一直是世界上悬索桥中最长的，而其桥塔使其成为直至1993年为止所有类型桥梁中最高的。
它在1989年经受住了一次破坏性地震，并在其建成后的前75年中仅因天气状况而关闭交通三次。
这座被誉为全球出镜率最高的桥梁的地标性建筑，于1994年被美国土木工程师协会评为美国七大土木工程奇观之一。

sentence_translations.sentence: O'Shaughnessy, Strauss and the Secretary to the Mayor of San Francisco believed a special district needed to be created, with responsibility for planning,designing and financing construction.

sentence_translations.sentence: The formation of this district would enable all the counties affected by the bridge to have a say in the proceedings.
sentence_translations.translation: 该区域的建立将使受大桥影响的各县在进程中有发言权。

sentence_translations.sentence: This happened in 1928, when the California legislature passed an act to establish the Golden Gate Bridge and Highway District, consisting of six counties.
sentence_translations.translation: 这一想法于1928年实现，当时加利福尼亚州立法机构通过法案，成立了由六个县组成的金门大桥和公路区。

sentence_translations.sentence: In 1930, residents voted on the question of whether to put up their homes, their farms and their business properties as security for a $35 million bond issue to finance construction.
sentence_translations.translation: 1930年，居民就是否将自己的房屋、农场和商业地产作为3500万美元债券发行的担保以资助建设进行投票。

sentence_translations.sentence: The outcome was a large majority in favour.
sentence_translations.translation: 结果是大多数人投了赞成票。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, the District struggled to find a financial backer amid the difficulties of the Great Depression, a problem made worse by years of expensive legal proceedings.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，在大萧条的困境中，该区难以找到财务支持者，而多年的昂贵法律诉讼使这一问题雪上加霜。

sentence_translations.sentence: Now desperate, Strauss personally sought help from the President of Bank of America, who provided a crucial boost by agreeing to buy $6 million in bonds in 1932.
sentence_translations.translation: 如今陷入绝望的斯特劳斯亲自向美国银行行长寻求帮助，后者同意在1932年购买600万美元的债券，从而提供了关键的推动。

sentence_translations.sentence: Construction began in January 1933, with the excavation of a vast amount of rock to establish the bridge's two anchorages - the structures in the ground that would take the tension from the suspension cables.
sentence_translations.translation: 工程于1933年1月开始，首先挖掘大量岩石以建立桥梁的两个锚碇——这些地面结构将承受来自悬索的拉力。

sentence_translations.sentence: The crew consisted of virtually anyone capable of withstanding the physical rigours of the job, as out-of-work cab drivers, farmers and clerks lined up for the chance to earn steady wages as ironworkers and cement mixers.
sentence_translations.translation: 施工队伍几乎由任何能够承受工作体力强度的人组成，失业的出租车司机、农民和职员排队等待机会，成为铁匠和水泥搅拌工以赚取稳定的工资。

sentence_translations.sentence: The attempt to build what would be the first bridge support in the open ocean proved an immense challenge.
sentence_translations.translation: 建造第一个位于开阔海洋中的桥梁支撑结构的尝试被证明是一个巨大的挑战。

sentence_translations.sentence: Working from a long framework built out from the San Francisco side, divers plunged to depths of 90 feet through strong currents to blast away rock and remove the debris.
sentence_translations.translation: 潜水员们从旧金山一侧延伸出的长框架出发，在强流中潜入90英尺深的水下，炸开岩石并清除碎屑。

sentence_translations.sentence: The framework was damaged when it was struck by a ship in August 1933 and again during a powerful storm later in the year, setting construction back five months.
sentence_translations.translation: 该框架在1933年8月被一艘船撞损，同年晚些时候又在一场猛烈风暴中受损，导致施工推迟了五个月。

sentence_translations.sentence: The two towers were completed in June 1935, and a New Jersey-based company was appointed to handle the on-site construction of the suspension cables.
sentence_translations.translation: 这两座塔楼于1935年6月完工，一家位于新泽西的公司被指定负责悬索的现场施工。

sentence_translations.sentence: Its engineers had mastered a technique in which individual steel wires were banded together in spools and carried across the length of the bridge on spinning wheels.
sentence_translations.translation: 其工程师掌握了一种技术，将单根钢丝捆扎成线轴，并通过旋转轮将其运送到整个桥面上。

sentence_translations.sentence: Given a year to complete the task, they instead finished in just over six months, having spun more than 25,000 individual wires into each massive cable.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽管任务被给予一年时间完成，但他们仅用六个多月就完工了，将超过25,000根单根钢丝编织成每根巨大的缆索。

sentence_translations.sentence: The roadway was completed in April 1937, and the bridge officially opened to pedestrians the following month.
sentence_translations.translation: 桥面于1937年4月完工，桥于次月正式向行人开放。

sentence_translations.sentence: The next day, President Roosevelt announced its opening via White House telegraph.
sentence_translations.translation: 次日，罗斯福总统通过白宫电报宣布大桥开通。

sentence_translations.sentence: The Golden Gate has endured as a marvel of modern engineering; its main span was the longest in the world for a suspension bridge until 1981, while its towers made it the tallest bridge of any type until 1993.
sentence_translations.translation: 金门大桥作为现代工程的奇迹经久不衰；其主跨距在1981年之前一直是世界上悬索桥中最长的，而其桥塔则使其成为1993年之前所有类型桥梁中最高的一座。

sentence_translations.sentence: It withstood a destructive earthquake in 1989 and was closed to traffic only three times in its first 75 years due to weather conditions.
sentence_translations.translation: 它经受住了1989年破坏性地震的考验，并在其最初75年间因天气原因仅对交通关闭了三次。

sentence_translations.sentence: Believed to be the most photographed bridge in the world, this landmark was named one of the seven civil engineering wonders of the United States by the American Society of Civil Engineers in 1994.
sentence_translations.translation: 这座被认为是世界上被拍摄次数最多的桥梁的地标性建筑，于1994年被美国土木工程师协会命名为美国七大土木工程奇观之一。

sentence_translations.translation: 金门大桥作为现代工程的奇迹屹立至今；
